description: Returns who to contact at VertoDigital and how: the named growth lead, their email and LinkedIn, the reply-time commitment and the contact-form URL. Use it when a user asks how to reach the team or who to talk to. To send a message on the user's behalf, use vertodigital_send_enquiry instead; for any other page, use vertodigital_get_page. format: "summary" is served from a fixed record inside the server, so it is instant and returns only the structured contact object; "full" (the default) fetches the live /contact page as markdown, including the form fields and the direct-message option.

format.description: "summary": structured object (name, title, location, email, LinkedIn, response SLA, contact form URL). "full" (default): the /contact page as markdown.

name: vertodigital_get_contact

markdown.description: The /contact page as markdown - present when format is "full"
